summary: Frontend-only testing of the new interactive 3D FAIRINO FR3-WMS robot centerpiece on the homepage. All acceptance criteria pass: model-viewer loads (~1s cold), robot renders upright with base at bottom, centered; clicking the hero-featured-card opens the Cobot Ultrasonic Welding case-study modal; clicking the hero-featured-chip opens the same modal; dragging the robot orbits it without opening the modal; modal closes cleanly and content/images are intact; mobile (390x844) shows the robot correctly. Navbar sections (Projects, Timeline, About) render; Resume module with QR is visible. No console errors — only benign Lit dev-mode notice and WebGL perf warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx uses Lit dev build of @google/model-viewer (dev-mode console warning). For production polish, consider pinning to the prod bundle or acknowledge warning is harmless.
model-viewer emits 'Element scheduled an update after an update completed' warning — cosmetic, from repeated attribute application; not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage centerpiece is a <model-viewer data-testid='hero-centerpiece'> loading /models/fairino-fr3-wms.glb (200, model/gltf-binary). Wrapper data-testid='hero-featured-card' and data-testid='hero-featured-chip' both call onOpenProject(featured) which opens ProjectModal with the Cobot case study. Model loads in ~1s in this env; still keep the up-to-20s wait for cold loads. Drag on the model orbits camera and correctly does not fire onClick.
